facts.fact: A novel approach is presented for automatically acquiring English topic signatures.
facts.supporting_span: We present a novel approach for automatically acquiring English topic signatures .

facts.fact: A topic signature is a set of words that tend to co-occur with a particular concept or word sense.
facts.supporting_span: Given a particular concept , or word sense , a topic signature is a set of words that tend to co-occur with it .

facts.fact: Topic signatures can be useful in a number of Natural Language Processing applications.
facts.supporting_span: Topic signatures can be useful in a number of Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications , such as Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) and Text Summarisation .
